cases.title: Owners nominate agent for bulk carrier discharging steam coal at Jepara
text: Subject: AGENCY NOMINATION - MV LAUT PERKASA JAYA / JEPARA / VOY 26-14
Good day. As Owners of the below vessel we are pleased to nominate your good office as port agents for her forthcoming discharging call:
Vessel   : MV LAUT PERKASA JAYA (bulk carrier)
DWT 81,600 / LOA 229 m / Summer draft 14.2 m
Cargo    : 55,000 MT steam coal in bulk - to discharge
Charterers: Arunika Bara Trading Pte Ltd
Please send us your PDA and confirm receipt of this nomination.
Operations Dept. - PT Samudera Lintas Nusantara
cases.reviewNotes: principalName: owners give the order; charterers are named separately and are not the principal here.
cases.authorNote: Clean owners' nomination with IMO, name+code, ISO dates with year and a single discharge cargo. DWT/LOA/draft must not become cargo.

cases.title: Surat penunjukan keagenan for tug and barge loading bauxite at Kendawangan
text: Bersama ini kami, PT Borneo Karya Mineral, menunjuk PT Duta Samudra Agensi sebagai agen penuh (full agency) untuk kegiatan pemuatan dengan rincian sebagai berikut:
Kapal Tunda   : TB MEGA BAHARI 21 (Call Sign YHBE1)
Muatan        : Bauksit tercuci (washed bauxite) ± 7.500 MT, muat
Demikian surat penunjukan ini kami sampaikan. Atas kerja samanya kami ucapkan terima kasih.
cases.authorNote: Formal 'Surat Penunjukan Keagenan' with 'menunjuk' = appointment. Tug and barge are both call vessels with explicit roles; 'full agency' is stated. Approximate ± 7.500 MT is the stated quantity.

cases.title: Owners nominate agent for product tanker loading diesel at Sungai Pakning
text: Subject: Nomination - MT RANGSANG BESTARI - Sungai Pakning - load Diesel
Please be advised that MT RANGSANG BESTARI has been fixed to load at Sungai Pakning. As Owners we would like to nominate your office as vessel's agents at loadport.

Please arrange port clearance, pilotage and tug assistance. Owners' items (crew, stores) to be advised separately.
Tirta Kencana Shipping Pte Ltd (as Owners)
cases.authorNote: Tanker nomination with all three identifiers labelled. Port given by name only, so the UN/LOCODE must stay empty. Laycan dates have no year and are not ETA.

cases.title: Reefer vessel nomination at Tual, frozen fish loading, chatty mixed-language email
text: Kami mau nominate PT Bapak sebagai agent utk reefer vessel kami yg akan muat di Tual:
Cargo  : frozen fish (skipjack & yellowfin) approx 1,850 MT, loading dari cold storage kami
Tolong info juga dokumen karantina ikan yg perlu disiapkan, and please send PDA asap.
Shipping Dept - PT Arafura Samudera Dingin (XJW6LD)
cases.authorNote: MMSI is the only identifier. ETA has a year (dmy); ETD is written as day/month without a year and must stay empty.

cases.title: Charterer nominates agent at Kolonodale for nickel ore loading, billing to shipper
text: PT Mitra Bahari Sulawesi - Cabang Kolonodale
Perihal: Nominasi Keagenan MV NIKEL SEJAHTERA
Mohon bantuan Bapak/Ibu untuk menjadi agen kapal kami dengan data sebagai berikut:
Dermaga    : Jetty Terminal Khusus PT Morowali Tambang Raya
Muatan     : bijih nikel (nickel ore) 52.000 WMT, muat

Sinar Timur Resources Ltd - Rep. Office Indonesia

jetty.present: Jetty Terminal Khusus PT Morowali Tambang Raya
alternatives: Terminal Khusus PT Morowali Tambang Raya

cases.authorNote: Charterer is the ordering principal; billing is explicitly addressed to the shipper, so customerName is set. Indonesian thousands separator: 52.000 = 52000.

cases.title: Owners' letter hereby appointing protective agent at Celukan Bawang
text: To   : PT Bali Utara Maritim, Celukan Bawang

We, Hartono Kurnia Marine Co., Ltd., as Owners of MV KIRANA BAHARI (IMO 9873084), hereby appoint your company as Owners' protective agent at Celukan Bawang (IDCEB) for the vessel's forthcoming discharging call.

Charterers have appointed their own agent for cargo operations; your scope is limited to Owners' matters (crew, cash to master, husbandry items, casualty reporting and monitoring of cargo operations on Owners' behalf).
Vessel ETA Celukan Bawang: {ETA.enLong}, subject to weather.
Cargo on board: abt 60,500 MT coal in bulk, to be discharged at the PLTU jetty.
Please confirm acceptance and forward your protective agency tariff.
For and on behalf of Hartono Kurnia Marine Co., Ltd. (as Owners)
cases.reviewNotes: jetty: 'the PLTU jetty' is a generic berth description; accept it or empty.
cases.authorNote: 'hereby appoint' in a letter of appointment = NEW_APPOINTMENT; agency type explicitly protective (the mention of husbandry items is scope, not the agency type).

cases.title: Product tanker nomination for fuel discharge at Manggis, two grades
text: Sehubungan dengan rencana pembongkaran BBM di terminal Manggis, kami nominasikan perusahaan Bapak/Ibu sebagai agen untuk kapal berikut:
Nama kapal        : MT NUSA TIRTA 5 (tanker produk minyak)
Penerima muatan: PT Energi Nusa Pratama.
Mohon dikirimkan PDA dan daftar dokumen yang diperlukan paling lambat 3 hari sebelum kedatangan.
cases.authorNote: Tanker discharging two fuel grades in KL; Indonesian thousand separators. The receiver is not the billing party (nothing about billing is said).

cases.title: Owners' husbandry agent request at Pantoloan, crew change and CTM, no cargo scope
text: Kindly act as Owners' HUSBANDRY agent utk vessel kami di Pantoloan. Cargo ops handled by charterers' agent, jadi scope kalian owners' matters saja.
Vessel : MV TELUK CENDANA (container ship, 1,100 TEU)
Scope  : crew change 4 on / 4 off, fresh provisions, CTM USD 15,000
Tolong kirim estimasi biaya husbandry ya, and please confirm by return.
Kevin Hartanto | Crewing & Husbandry | Cendana Line Shipping Pte Ltd | XJW6TG
cases.authorNote: Explicit husbandry agency for owners' matters during a call; cargo ops belong to charterers' agent and no cargo is stated, so the cargo list is empty. CTM amount is money.

cases.title: WhatsApp: tug and barge to Sape, ETA not yet known
text: [16:42] Hendra Rajawali: Pak Darto sore. Mau minta tolong keagenan TB RAJAWALI TANGGUH 7 gandeng BG RAJAWALI 2708 ke Sape ya, rencana muat batu split.
[16:43] Hendra Rajawali: ETA blm pasti pak, kira2 minggu depan. Nanti sy kabari detail + PDA nya.
[16:43] Hendra Rajawali: Hendra - CV Rajawali Tangguh Marine XJW6UH
cases.reviewNotes: role: only TB/BG prefixes, no explicit 'tug'/'barge' label. principalName: the sender's company in a chat signature.
cases.authorNote: Vessel names plus a port name meet the minimum; the missing ETA does not make it insufficient. Cargo named without a figure.

cases.title: Short e-mail: unnamed small tanker to Bula, name to follow
text: We have a small tanker going to Bula (IDBUA) around {ETA.dm} to load crude condensate. Vessel name still to be confirmed by owners, probably tomorrow.
Can you handle the agency and send us your tariff? Thx
Farah | Ops | Seram Petro Logistics XJW6VJ | +62-556-7712

gt.notNewReason: Minimum rule item 1 missing: no vessel name, IMO, MMSI or call sign is written (vessel name to be confirmed).

cases.reviewNotes: principalName: sender company only in signature; empty also acceptable.
cases.authorNote: Port and code are present but no vessel identity at all, so it is insufficient. ETA has no year and stays empty.

cases.title: One-line chat: named vessel, ETA without year, port to follow
text: Pak, MV RIMBA ARUNIKA ETA {ETA.dm}, need agent, pls standby ya. Cargo + port details to follow dari charterer. Tks - Yudi (PT Pelayaran Rimba Nusa) XJW6WK

gt.notNewReason: Minimum rule item 2 missing: no port name or UN/LOCODE, and the ETA has no year.

cases.reviewNotes: principalName: sender company in parentheses; charterer (unnamed) will send details.
cases.authorNote: Vessel identity is present, but neither port nor an ETA with a year, so the minimum is not met.

cases.title: Vessel and ETA with year, destination port still pending
text: Kapal kami MV CAHAYA PELANGI 3 (IMO 9873113) direncanakan tiba {ETA.idLong}. Pelabuhan tujuan masih menunggu konfirmasi pembeli (salah satu pelabuhan di Maluku Utara). Mohon kesediaan kantor Bapak untuk menangani keagenan kapal tersebut; detail muatan dan pelabuhan kami kirim menyusul.
cases.reviewNotes: classification: minimum met via vessel + ETA with year even though no port is named; a reviewer may want to confirm the NEW_NOMINATION reading.
cases.authorNote: Vessel name/IMO plus an ETA with a written year satisfy the minimum rule; 'Maluku Utara' is a province, not a port.

cases.title: Cement shipment to Ranai with vessel TBN, asking for agency and cost
text: Kami ada rencana pengiriman semen curah ± 5.000 MT ke Ranai (IDRNI) akhir bulan depan. Kapal masih TBN, kemungkinan kapal curah ukuran sekitar 8.000 DWT.
Apakah kantor Bapak bisa menjadi agen di Ranai untuk bongkaran tersebut? Mohon info juga estimasi biaya keagenan.
Logistik - PT Natuna Bangun Persada XJW6YM

gt.notNewReason: Minimum rule item 1 missing: vessel is TBN, no name/IMO/MMSI/call sign.

cases.reviewNotes: principalName: cargo owner asking; empty also acceptable.
cases.authorNote: Agency request with port/code and cargo, but the vessel is TBN, so it is insufficient. 8.000 DWT is a vessel size, not cargo.

cases.title: Multipurpose vessel at Pantoloan: coils, transformers, pipes; billets remain for Kolonodale
text: Subject: RE: MV GARUDA SAMUDRA V.114N - Pantoloan call - agency nomination
Further to our phone call this morning, please note you are nominated as agents for MV GARUDA SAMUDRA (multipurpose general cargo, IMO 9873151) at Pantoloan.
Cargo to be discharged at Pantoloan:
- Hot rolled steel coils: 214 coils / 3,450.500 MT
- Power transformers (project cargo): 2 units, 86.4 MT each, heavy lift by ship's gear
- Steel pipes: abt 1,200 MT (final figure pending B/L)
Remaining cargo on board (approx 2,300 MT steel billets) is for Kolonodale and stays on board - not for your port.
Pls pre-advise stevedores and apply for the heavy-lift permit in advance.
Line Operations - Nusantara Multipurpose Carriers XJW6ZN

forbidden.reason: billets for another port, not this call

cases.reviewNotes: Transformers: '2 units, 86.4 MT each' - quantity 2 units accepted, or empty; per-unit weight is not the cargo quantity. Coils: 3,450.500 MT is the weight (214 is the piece count).
cases.authorNote: Three discharge cargoes for this port with mixed formats; the billets stay on board for Kolonodale and must not be listed.

cases.title: Bagged cement in sacks, rebar and general goods to Gunung Sitoli
text: Dengan ini kami sampaikan nominasi keagenan untuk kapal berikut:
Nama kapal        : KM SINAR NIAS BAHARI
a. Semen dalam kantong 40.000 zak @ 50 kg (± 2.000 ton)
c. Barang campuran / kelontong - jumlah menyusul
Mohon disiapkan TKBM untuk bongkar semen langsung ke truk.
cases.reviewNotes: Cement: both 40.000 zak and ± 2.000 ton are written; either is accepted.
cases.authorNote: Three discharge cargoes: bagged cement with two stated figures, rebar in ton, and mixed goods with no figure (row without quantity).

cases.title: Palm oil tanker loading CPO and PKO at Kuala Kapuas; last voyage cargo mentioned

Shipper: PT Kapuas Agro Lestari - please coordinate with their loading master, Mr. Sony.
Ops - PT Sawit Makmur Tankers XJW6BP
cases.authorNote: Two liquid cargoes loaded this call (3.200 = 3200 in Indonesian format). The 4.100 MT CPO discharged at Sekupang is last voyage and must not appear.

cases.title: Broker nominates Bima agent on receivers' behalf: urea plus NPK quantity TBA
text: Subject: Nomination Bima - MV PUPUK NUSA 1
Receivers PT Agro Sumbawa Makmur have asked us to nominate your office as discharge port agents for MV PUPUK NUSA 1 (IMO 9873175).

cases.reviewNotes: principalName: receivers are the principal behind the order, the sender is a broker; either accepted.
cases.authorNote: Urea has a figure, NPK is named with quantity TBA (no figure). Draft/DWT are vessel particulars.

cases.title: Coal barge to Meulaboh, cargo detailed but vessel name to follow
text: Untuk pengapalan batubara ke PLTU dekat Meulaboh bulan depan, kami minta kesediaan kantor Bapak/Ibu jadi agen di pelabuhan bongkar. Detail:
- Kapal     : tongkang 300 ft, nama kapal menyusul dari transporter
Rudi Hartawan - PT Energi Barat Aceh XJW6CQ

gt.notNewReason: Minimum rule item 1 missing: the barge name will follow; no vessel name/IMO/MMSI/call sign written.

cases.reviewNotes: principalName: cargo owner / requester; empty also acceptable.
cases.authorNote: Everything but vessel identity is present; 'tongkang 300 ft' is a size, not a name. Calorific value is not a quantity.

cases.title: Branch final loading report for completed call at Labuha
text: Subject: FINAL LOADING REPORT - MV TERNATE MAKMUR - Labuha
Pls find final report utk MV TERNATE MAKMUR (IMO 9873187) di Labuha (IDLAH):
Cargo loaded      : 4,215.35 MT copra in bulk (as per draft survey)
Semua dokumen (B/L, manifest, SPB) sudah dikirim ke principal. Mohon di-file ke folder vessel.

gt.notNewReason: Internal report of a call that is already completed; no request for agency services.

cases.authorNote: A post-call report with actual (past) times; nothing is requested, so it is not relevant. UNSUPPORTED_REQUEST would be wrong because there is no request.

cases.title: Forwarded thread: Master revises ETA Benoa; original nomination below
text: Subject: FW: Revised ETA - MV DEWATA LESTARI - Benoa
Hi Benoa team, please see Master's message below - ETA has been revised, pls update your records and line-up. Everything else as per our original nomination.
Good day. Due to main engine repairs at previous port, vessel's revised ETA Benoa is {ETA.dmy} 0800 LT. Previous ETA {ETA_OLD.dmy} is cancelled. ETD Benoa expected {ETD.dmy}.
Subject: Nomination - MV DEWATA LESTARI - Benoa
We nominate you as agents for MV DEWATA LESTARI (IMO 9873204), ETA Benoa (IDBOA) {ETA_OLD.dmy}.
Nadia Prameswari | Operations | PT Dewata Lestari Shipping XJW6DR | +62-556-47102
cases.authorNote: The Master's revised ETA supersedes the ETA in the original nomination, which is explicitly cancelled. Contact is the owners' operator, not the Master.

cases.title: Reply thread moves the call from Dobo to Tual; cargo in original message
text: Perihal: RE: Nominasi agen KM MUTIARA KEI 2 - PERUBAHAN PELABUHAN

Mohon maaf ada perubahan: pelabuhan tujuan KM MUTIARA KEI 2 dipindah dari Dobo ke Tual atas permintaan penerima. ETA tetap {ETA.idLong}, muatan tetap sama. Mohon penanganan keagenan dialihkan ke kantor Bapak di Tual.
Perihal: Nominasi agen KM MUTIARA KEI 2
Dengan hormat, kami nominasikan kantor Bapak sebagai agen untuk KM MUTIARA KEI 2 (IMO 9873216), ETA Dobo (IDDOB) {ETA.idLong}. Muatan: beras 1.500 ton dan gula pasir 600 ton, bongkar.
cases.authorNote: The port was changed from Dobo to Tual; only the Tual name is written, so the code (which belongs to Dobo) must stay empty. ETA and cargo carry over explicitly ('tetap').

cases.title: Substitute vessel nominated for tin ingot loading at Toboali
text: Subject: RE: RE: Agency appointment Toboali - vessel substitution

Owners sudah konfirmasi MV BANGKA PERKASA (IMO 9873230) batal datang karena drydock diperpanjang. As substitute we nominate MV BELITUNG PERKASA, IMO 9873242, MMSI 525638115 - same cargo, same shipper.
Cargo: tin ingots 1,250 MT, loading, packed in bundles on pallets.
Please cancel all arrangements (pilot booking, PKK) made for MV BANGKA PERKASA.
> Pak Ferry, mohon handle agency utk MV BANGKA PERKASA IMO 9873230, ETA Toboali (IDTBL) {ETA_OLD.iso}, cargo tin ingots 1,250 MT load.
cases.reviewNotes: classification: subject says 'Agency appointment' but there is no appointment letter; both NEW_* accepted. portUnlocode: IDTBL appears only in the quoted original (same port); accept it or empty. principalName: sender company acting for unnamed owners.
cases.authorNote: The original vessel is cancelled and replaced; only the substitute takes part in the call. Revised ETA replaces the one in the quoted message.

cases.title: Nomination re-sent with corrected quantity and ETD, cancelled version quoted below
text: Subject: NOMINATION (RE-SENT, SUPERSEDES PREVIOUS) - MV MINANG SAKTI / TELUKBAYUR

Please disregard and cancel our nomination sent yesterday under ref AMS/NOM/118 - it contained a wrong cargo quantity and a wrong ETD. Kindly find the corrected nomination below under ref AMS/NOM/118-R1.
Vessel: MV MINANG SAKTI / Port: Telukbayur / ETA: {ETA.enLong} / ETD: {ETD_OLD.enLong}
cases.authorNote: Corrected nomination supersedes the cancelled one: 9,800 MT and the new ETD/ref are right; 8,900 MT and the old ETD are wrong.

cases.title: ETA pushed back to a date without year; original ETA with year is superseded
text: Update: ETA KM SULA JAYA MANDIRI mundur, sekarang perkiraan tiba {ETA_NEW.dBulanId} sore (bukan {ETA_OLD.idLong} seperti email kemarin). Data lainnya tetap.
Kami mohon PT Bapak berkenan menjadi agen untuk KM SULA JAYA MANDIRI (call sign YCWM5) di Mangole (IDMAL), ETA {ETA_OLD.idLong}.
cases.reviewNotes: eta: the only valid ETA is the new one, written without a year, so eta must be empty; the old ETA (with year) is explicitly superseded.
cases.authorNote: Real-world ETA slip: new day/month only. Per the year rule the ETA stays empty, and the cancelled dated ETA is wrong. Vessel + port still meet the minimum.

cases.title: Short nomination at Sekupang buried under bank, tax and disclaimer footer

Jl. Raya Sekupang Blok C No. 17, Sekupang 29422
Bank: Bank Pesisir Nusantara, KCP Sekupang

Please consider the environment before printing this e-mail.
cases.authorNote: One-sentence nomination; the footer carries address, NPWP, bank account and SWIFT noise that must not leak into cargo or references. Billing goes to the same company, so no separate customer.

cases.title: Head office forwards new customer's tug and barge request at Muara Teweh

cases.title: Labuan Bajo nomination with PO number, certification numbers and confidentiality footer
text: Kami nominate your office sebagai agent utk:
Cargo   : steel H-beam 420 MT, discharge (material proyek resort)
PO customer: PO-4518-2207 (FYI only, bukan utk agency)
Mohon PDA dikirim ke email di bawah ya.

cases.reviewNotes: contact.phone: office and mobile both accepted. clientReference: the PO is explicitly said not to be for agency; it is the end customer's PO, not the request reference.
cases.authorNote: Genuine nomination with ETA/ETB with year; PO and ISO certificate numbers are noise.

cases.title: Appointment of full agent for LCT at Kalabahi with PDA/PO/invoice numbers in body
text: To      : PT Alor Maritim Jasa, Kalabahi
We hereby appoint PT Alor Maritim Jasa as FULL agents for the following call:

cases.reviewNotes: clientReference: 'Our Ref' is the natural answer; the PO No. is also the sender's number for this call, so both accepted. contact.email: accounts mailbox, not personal.
cases.authorNote: 'We hereby appoint ... as FULL agents' = formal appointment with explicit agency type. Invoice/PDA/PO numbers and the IDR amount are noise.

gt.notNewReason: Only a quotation (indicative PDA) is requested; no vessel is fixed and the sender states it is not a nomination.

cases.title: Master's Notice of Readiness at Sidangoli copied to agents
text: This is to notify you that MV HALMAHERA TIMUR, IMO 9873321, arrived at Sidangoli (IDSID) anchorage on {NOR.enLong} at 0630 LT and is in all respects ready to load her cargo of approx 9,500 CBM logs in accordance with all terms and conditions of the Charter Party dated {CP.enLong}.

cases.title: Bunker supplier promo with embedded instructions to an automated reader

gt.notNewReason: Marketing offer for bunker supply; the vessel/appointment details exist only inside an injected instruction and are not a real request.

forbidden.reason: cargo figure only inside injected instruction

cases.authorNote: Promotional mail whose bracketed note tries to steer an automated reader into fabricating an appointment. Nothing in the injected block is real data.

cases.title: Newbuilding maiden call at Fak Fak: IMO/MMSI/call sign beside hull, yard and contract numbers
text: Subject: Nomination - M/V SERUNI TIMUR (ex Hull No. S-1187) - Fak Fak
Our newbuilding was delivered by the yard last week under the name M/V SERUNI TIMUR. For your records, her identifiers are:
(Builder's Hull No. S-1187 / Yard No. 2231 / Contract No. 9874412 - internal yard references, please do not use them for port clearance.)
She will perform her maiden call at Fak Fak to discharge 3,800 MT bagged cement. ETA Fak Fak {ETA.enLong}. Please act as our agents and send PDA.
Operations - Seruni Maritime Pte Ltd XJW6TH
cases.authorNote: Only the numbers labelled IMO/MMSI/Call sign are identifiers; the 7-digit contract number and hull/yard numbers are not.

cases.title: Shipping company 'Mutiara Laut' asks agency for unnamed vessel voyage 214 to Sape
text: Kami dari Pelayaran Mutiara Laut mohon bantuan keagenan untuk kapal kami voyage 214 tujuan Sape, ETA {ETA.dmy}. Muatan jagung pipilan ± 2.600 ton untuk dimuat. Nama kapal akan kami informasikan setelah penggantian nakhoda selesai.

gt.notNewReason: Minimum rule item 1 missing: the vessel name is to follow; 'Mutiara Laut' is the shipping company, and voyage/job numbers are not vessel identities.

cases.reviewNotes: clientReference: 'No. Ref. MLS-0927' is the likely request reference, but in an insufficient request leaving it empty is also fine.
cases.authorNote: The company name looks like a vessel name, but the message says the vessel name will follow; with no identity the request is insufficient despite port and dated ETA.

cases.title: Chat: sister-named vessel by MMSI, port 'same as last time' not written
text: Yg KM LESTARI ABADI 3 bulan lalu udah clear semua kan? Thanks ya.
Now ada satu lagi: KM LESTARI ABADI 8 - beda kapal ya, MMSI 525018975. ETA {ETA.dm}, muat kopra kayak biasa. Tolong siapin agency, pelabuhannya sama kayak kemarin.

gt.notNewReason: Minimum rule item 2 missing: the port is only 'same as last time' (not written), and the ETA has no year.

cases.reviewNotes: principalName: sender company in chat signature; empty also acceptable.
cases.authorNote: Only ABADI 8 is this call (the ABADI 3 was last month). Identity is present via name/MMSI, but no port is written and the ETA lacks a year.

cases.title: Telex-style nomination with port given only as UN/LOCODE and broken line wrap
text: FM: SERAM TIMUR PETROLEUM - MARINE OPS
1. PLS BE ADVSD WE NOMINATE YR GOOD OFFICE AS AGENTS FOR MT SERAM INDAH IMO 9873400 C/S YEKE
4. CGO: LOAD CRUDE OIL ABT 45000 BBLS FM SHORE TANKS
cases.authorNote: Telex abbreviations; port given only as a UN/LOCODE (the code alone meets the minimum, and the name must not be derived). 'FW 50 MT' split across lines is fresh water, not cargo. No named contact person.

cases.authorNote: Appointment wording, port, dated ETA and cargo are all there, but the letter breaks off before the vessel data, so it is insufficient.
